in_sanskrit.name: Gajinder
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Elephant god
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gajinder एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Gajinder is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Gaja', which means elephant. This name is associated with the Hindu god Ganesha, who is known as the elephant-headed god and the remover of obstacles. The name signifies strength, wisdom, and the power to overcome challenges.
